title: Towards Weakly-Supervised Hate Speech Classification Across Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1) of weakly-supervised text classification models in detecting sexist hate speech and hate speech targeting women in both in-dataset and cross-dataset settings.
Evaluating the performance of weakly-supervised text classification models in detecting racist hate speech and hate speech targeting Black and Asian populations across different datasets.
Evaluating the performance of weakly-supervised text classification models in detecting hate speech targeting Jewish and Muslim populations across different datasets.
Evaluating the performance of weakly-supervised text classification models in detecting hate speech targeting LGBT individuals across different datasets.
